main_text.p: 6. Secūdum quantitatem syllogismus dicitur Universalis vel speciālis.
8. Peccatum igitur ratiocinationis est partim in materia, partim in forma.
9. Peccatum in materia est modo Gravius, modo Levius.
10. Peccatum in materia est vel in Rebus, vel in Verbis, ut rerum & sententiæ symbolis.
11. Peccatū ratiocinationis est vel simplex, vel multiplex.
12. Simplex, cūm tantum vel in Rebus, vel in Forma peccatur.
main_text.head: CAP. II,
main_text.p: 1. Peccatum in rebus est vel in quæstione, vel in sumptionibus, seu præmissis.
2. Cūm sophisma est in quæstione, solutio fit vel Rejectione quæstionis, vel simplici seu pura concessione.
3. Rejectio seu ἀντιλήψις [?] quæstionis est vel alienæ, vel multiplicis,

page.notes: Greek word in item 3 read as ἀντιλήψις with doubt over the letters; the scan is faint there. Catchword "4. Alie-" is set apart at the lower right and is kept as a catchword, not as paragraph text. Italic in item 2 covers "Cūm sophisma est in quæstione, solutio fit"; the word "fit" is italic on the scan. Spelling and abbreviations kept as printed.
